name: Crystal Mountain Herbs
description: Frostcap Shimmerleaf Description: This herb has radiant blue leaves perpetually encased in frost, a chill that defies the warmth of any surrounding climate. Effect. Eating raw Frostcap Shimmerleaf grants resistance to cold damage for 1 hour. Harvesting. A DC 15 Intelligence (Nature) check is required. Alchemical Uses. Icerunner Elixir: Incorporating this elixir into a potion bestows upon the drinker the ability to traverse icy terrain with ease, negating any slippery conditions for 24 hours. Frostguard Salve: When applied as a salve, it shields the skin against the ravages of extreme cold, granting immunity to natural icy environmental effects for 8 hours. Special Use: The innate cold-preserving properties of the Frostcap Shimmerleaf make it an essential stabilizer for other concoctions. Potions that normally deteriorate rapidly can retain their efficacy for years when imbued with this leaf. This preservation quality allows for the mass production of certain remedies, proving invaluable in medical treatments across the realms. Skyward Blossom Description. This blossom bears petals that glisten with the ephemeral light of dawn, believed to be imbued with the celestial realms. Effect. When utilized as a material component in spellcasting, the Skyward Blossom triples the duration of any spell that grants the power of flight. Harvesting. A DC 18 Intelligence (Nature) check is required. Alchemical Uses: Ethereal Tincture: When this tincture is imbibed, the drinker can experience the effects of the etherealness spell for a duration of up to 10 minutes. Celestial Infusion: Consuming this infusion grants the drinker an advantage on Charisma checks for 1 hour as their skin emits a soft, heavenly luminescence. Special Use: Skyward Blossom can be used to create a highly potent variant of holy water that can ward off undead. Undead attempting to enter or pass through ground wet with this holy water must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to cross. Glaciermint Description. Glaciermint is a resilient herb that prospers amidst the frigid landscape, emitting a mist of palpable chill. Effect. When consumed, Glaciermint grants the user the ability to unleash a 15-foot cone of frosty breath, causing 7d6 cold damage to all creatures within the area. Affected creatures may make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw for half damage. This ability must be used within one hour of Glaciermint’s consumption and can be used only once. Harvesting. A DC 16 Intelligence (Nature) check is required. Alchemical Uses: Frostbite Vial: This throwable alchemical weapon shatters upon impact, dealing 7d6 cold damage to all creatures within a 5-foot radius from where it fell. Chillbane Draught: When this potent draught is consumed, it grants the imbiber the fortitude to endure submersion in icy waters without suffering cold damage for up to 1 hour. Special Use: Glaciermint is especially prized as a trade item among those seeking to curry favor with white dragons, who find the herb to be a particularly delectable treat and greatly value them for its rarity Special Use: Glaciermint is especially prized as a trade item among those seeking to curry favor with white dragons, who find the herb to be a particularly delectable treat and greatly value them for its rarity.
